blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
blocks.zh: 测试时间缩放已成为推理模型的关键推论策略,一个模型会产生大量候选解决方案,希望至少找到一个正确的解决方案. 在计算完成所有候选人解决方案时可能要求很高,因此,最近的工作在只产生一个短的前缀之后便对候选人人才库进行精选,只对幸存的候选人进行进一步计算。 现行战略大致分为两类: 基于质量的方法为每个部分解决方案分配一个分数,并丢弃那些预计最终会导致不正确的最终解决方案的方法,而基于多样性的方法选择部分解决方案,这些解决方案遵循不同的推理轨迹,因此很可能涵盖不同的最终解决方案. 这两个目标之间的紧张关系是勘探与开发的一个例子,然而,以前几乎没有任何关于钻探的工作直接暴露了这种取舍,更不用说优化了。 在本文中,我们采用了一种套用程序,通过优化选定解决方案池的通过率,直接解决这种权衡问题。 特别是,它选择池子是为了最大限度地增加其至少一个部分解决方案在继续完成时得出正确答案的可能性。 因为这一目标同时奖励高质量的部分解决办法,并惩罚它们之间的冗余,所以质量和多样性自然是由标准本身而不是通过单独的临时设计选择来平衡的。 在8个开放量的推理模型上,我们的方法比现有的基于质量和多样性的计算策略要好。 当钻探程序为持续生成保留了一定数量的局部解决方案时,收益尤其显著,凸显了钻探过程中直接平衡质量和多样性的价值.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning, showcasing a strong aptitude for solving complex problems that require multi-step logic [ 45 , 21 , 52 , 18 , 15 ] . To further enhance these capabilities, test-time scaling has emerged as a prominent strategy, where generating multiple candidate solutions for a single problem allows the model to explore diverse reasoning strategies and achieve substantially better final performance [ 35 , 44 , 3 , 48 ] . However, a significant challenge in scaling test-time compute is the prohibitive cost of generating many full solutions, which we refer to as rollouts moving forward [ 33 , 23 ] . Beyond generation, there is also the cost of evaluating the finished rollouts in best-of- N N methods, which score each rollout with a reward model, and this is computationally demanding on a large pool of long reasoning traces [ 11 , 26 , 36 ] . This computational bottleneck, both in generation and in evaluating all N N rollouts in best-of- N N methods, necessitates test-time pruning of partial rollouts before they reach a final answer and terminate. In other words, we generate all N N rollouts only up to a cutoff of T T tokens, keep the k k most promising of them and run those to the full token budget B B , as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在复杂推理方面表现出了卓越的能力,展现出解决需要多步逻辑的复杂问题的强大能力[45,21,52,18,15]. 为了进一步加强这些能力,试验时间的缩放已成为一项突出的战略,在这个战略中,为单一问题提出多个候选人解决办法,使模型能够探索不同的推理战略,并大大改善最终业绩[35、44、3、48]。 然而,在计算测试时间方面的一个重大挑战是产生许多全面解决办法的高昂费用,我们称之为 " 推开 " [33、23]。 除了世代之外,还有以最佳N方法评价已完成的推出的成本,每一次推出都以奖励模式评分,这在计算上要求大量长推理痕迹[11,26,36]. 这一计算瓶颈,无论是在生成方面还是在以N N最佳方法评价NN所有推出时,都要求测试时间在获得最后答案并终止之前进行部分推出。 换句话说,如图1所示,我们只生产所有NN的推出量,直到T令牌被截断,使kk最有前途,并运行到全部令牌预算BB。

blocks.en: One family of methods examines the confidence dynamics of the model during generation, utilizing metrics such as logit entropy or confidence [ 30 , 50 , 17 , 43 ] . The underlying intuition is that if a model is overly confident at an intermediate decoding step, extending the reasoning process is a waste of compute; conversely, if the model is entirely lacking in confidence, it is unlikely to reach a correct solution regardless of the additional compute provided, allowing for early termination. Another line of work leverages the model’s internal state, specifically the hidden states of its transformer blocks, to identify which rollouts are worth continuing [ 54 , 1 ] . By “probing” these internal states, one can predict whether the model will ultimately arrive at a correct solution, effectively framing the pruning problem as a classification task. This allows for the early discarding of partial rollouts that are unlikely to yield a correct final answer. In parallel, a separate line of research prioritizes representation exploration (RepExp) to select a subset of rollouts that cover as many distinct reasoning strategies as possible [ 39 ] . By selecting partial rollouts whose corresponding embeddings are dissimilar, RepExp aims to explore a diverse set of reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 一套方法研究了模型在生成过程中的置信力动态,利用了诸如对数等指标或置信 [30、50、17、43]。 根本的直觉是,如果一个模型在中间解码步骤上过于自信,扩展推理过程是浪费了计算;反之,如果模型完全缺乏信心,无论提供的额外计算,都不可能达成正确的解决方案,从而可以提前终止. 另一行工作利用模型的内部状态,特别是其变压器块的隐藏状态,以确定哪些推出值得继续[54, 1]. 通过“试验”这些内部状态,人们可以预测该模型是否最终将得出正确的解决方案,有效地将打压问题确定为分类任务。 这样可以及早放弃部分推出,而这不可能产生正确的最终答案。 同时,单独一行的研究将代表性探索列为优先事项(RepExp),以选择一个子集,涵盖尽可能多的不同的推理战略[39]. RepExp通过选择部分展开,其相应的嵌入是相异的,旨在探索一套多样的推理轨迹.

blocks.en: These approaches, however, sit at the two ends of a spectrum, and neither directly optimizes the quantity we actually care about. The problem with probing methods is that the rollouts they rank highest tend to be similar to one another. As a result, the probe may be confidently wrong about all of the kept rollouts at once, and none of them reaches a correct answer. This is the problem of pure exploitation ( Fig. 2 a). RepExp, on the other hand, finds diverse rollouts, but because it ignores the quality of the rollouts, it can spend much of its budget on rollouts that are unlikely to succeed ( Fig. 2 b). These limitations motivate selecting the rollouts by the metric we actually want to optimize, choosing the set S S of k k rollouts that maximizes pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k , that is, max | S | = k ⁡ pass ​ @ ​ k ​ ( S ) \max_{|S|=k}\mathrm{pass}@k(S) , which we formalize in Eq. 3 . Optimizing this objective directly keeps the selected rollouts diverse enough to avoid shared failures while still favoring high-quality ones ( Fig. 2 c).
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法处于一个光谱的两端,两者都不直接优化我们实际关心的数量。 探险方法的问题在于,它们排位最高的推出往往相类似. 因此,探测器可能信心十足地错误地一次地对所保持的所有展开进行判断,而且没有一个得到正确的答案. 这是纯粹剥削的问题(图2a)。 另一方面,RepExp发现推出方式各异,但由于它忽略了推出的质量,它可以将预算的大部分花在推出上,而推出不太可能成功(图2b). 这些限制促使我们按照我们真正想要优化的度量来选择推出, 选择最能通过@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 的 s 的 s s , 即: 最大 S = k → 通过 @ k (S)\ max_{| S|=k}\ mathrm{ pass}@k (S), 我们在 Eq. 3 中正式确定 。 优化这一目标可以直接使选定的推出活动保持足够的多样性,以避免共同的失败,同时仍然倾向于高质量的(图2c).

blocks.en: To this end, we propose PKTP ( P ass@ 𝒌 \mathbfit{k} T hought P runing), a pruning framework that chooses the kept rollouts by maximizing pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k directly. The main difficulty is that, even if the rollouts are sampled independently, their outcomes are not independent (conditioned on the partial observation of the rollout). Hence, pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k depends on their joint distribution (i.e., rollouts with similar partial rollouts tend to succeed or fail together). We model this joint distribution with a latent Gaussian model, in which the correctness of each rollout is obtained by thresholding a Gaussian score. Evaluating pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k under this model requires an expectation over the latent variables, so we instead derive a closed-form second-order approximation of it. We show that this approximation is submodular, enabling us to approximately solve it using a greedy procedure to find a subset of size k k . An important aspect of the proposed framework is that the latent model is trained only once and does not depend on k k , and a single greedy pass yields a nested sequence of subsets, so the budget k k can be chosen online at inference time without retraining.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议PKTP( Pass@ k\ mathbfit{k}) Thought P runing),是一款直接通过最大通过@ k\mathrm{ pass}@k来选择所保持的展开的普跑框架. 主要困难是,即使推出是独立抽样的,其结果也不独立(以推出的部分观察为条件). 因此,通过@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 取决于它们的联合分布(即推出类似部分推出往往同时成功或失败)。 我们用潜在的高斯模型来模拟这种联合分布,其中每次推出的正确性都是通过对高斯的分数进行阈值来获得的. 在此模式下评价通过@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 需要期望潜在变量, 因此我们得出一个闭式二等近似值 。 我们显示这个近似是亚模块, 使我们能够用一个贪婪的程序 来找到一个大小 k k 的子集。 拟议框架的一个重要方面是,潜在模型只经过一次培训,并不依赖于kk,一个贪婪的传出一个嵌入子集的序列,因此预算kk可以在不进行再培训的情况下在网上选择.

blocks.en:
First, we cast pruning as maximizing the pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k of the kept set, and we model how similar rollouts fail together.
Second, we derive a closed-form, submodular approximation of pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k that links the probe and RepExp.
Third, through experiments on eight reasoning models, we show that PKTP improves over existing pruning methods, especially for moderate values of k k .

首先,我们把普鲁斯投放为将保存的套件的出道口(@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k)最大化, 我们模拟类似的推出如何一起失败。
其次,我们得出一个闭合形式,子模块相近的通道@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k, 连接了探测器和RepExp.
第三,通过对8个推理模型的实验,我们显示PKTP比起现有的回推法有所改进,特别是对于 k k 的中值.

blocks.en:
Given a question 𝒒 \mathbfit{q} , we draw N N candidate reasoning rollouts y ( i ) ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ 𝒒 ) y^{(i)}\sim\pi(\,\cdot\mid\mathbfit{q}\,) from a model π \pi . Each rollout is observed only through its first T T tokens, the prefix y 1 : T ( i ) y_{1:T}^{(i)} . We encode this prefix as a representation vector h i = h ( y 1 : T ( i ) ) h_{i}=h\!\left(y_{1:T}^{(i)}\right) , a hidden-state embedding of the reasoning up to token T. Pruning then keeps k ≤ N k\leq N rollouts, runs them to the full token budget B B , and discards the rest. A completed rollout y 1 : B y_{1:B} is either correct or not, recorded by the sign C ( y 1 : B ) ∈ { − 1 , + 1 } C(y_{1:B})\in\{-1,+1\} , C ( y 1 : B ) = { + 1 , if Verify ( y 1 : B ) , − 1 , otherwise . C(y_{1:B})\;=\;\begin{cases}+1,&\text{if }\text{{Verify}}\!\left(y_{1:B}\right),\\[2.0pt]
-1,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases} (1) Here Verify is a task-specific checker that returns true exactly when a completed rollout reaches a correct final answer, for instance by matching a reference solution on a math problem or passing the unit tests on a coding task. We write C ⁡ ( y ( i ) ) C(y^{(i)}) for the outcome of the i i -th rollout once it is run to the budget B B .

To prune partial rollouts, we need to map each prefix to a vector that captures its essential information. One line of work relies on hand-designed features of the rollout and the model’s internal states, such as token confidence, the geometry of the hidden-state trajectory, or the convergence of intermediate answers. These features are usually very low dimensional [ 13 , 40 , 38 , 19 , 28 ] . A second line of work instead keeps the hidden states of the transformer and pools them into a single vector [ 42 , 39 , 29 ] , and this is the class we use. In particular, we take h i h_{i} to be an exponential moving average (EMA) of the hidden states, which has proven an effective pooling operation [ 29 ] . Our improvements are thus shown for this class of embeddings, although our framework can be applied to other embeddings as well. Appendix F gives the details of the representation we use.

blocks.en: Existing pruning methods score each rollout on its own, using the model’s confidence [ 30 , 13 ] , a reward model [ 36 ] , or a probe on its hidden states [ 54 , 25 ] , or they select a diverse set, as RepExp does [ 39 ] . Pass@ k k has also been used as a training objective for reasoning models [ 41 , 8 ] , but not to decide which partial rollouts to keep. Outside of language models, choosing a set so that at least one item succeeds has been studied in information retrieval and Bayesian optimization [ 6 , 34 , 46 ] . Appendix G gives an extended discussion. In what follows, we discuss how such an objective can be solved.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: There are some challenges in solving Eq. 3 : First, we need to obtain the pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k of a given set of rollouts. We address this by learning the joint distribution of the rollouts’ outcomes under a probabilistic model, from which the pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k of any set can be estimated. Second, even with such an estimate, finding the subset of k k rollouts with the highest estimated pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k is a mixed-integer program. We can therefore view our framework as two components, learning the joint distribution of the outcomes ( Section 3.1 ), and solving this mixed-integer program at selection time ( Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在解决 Eq. 3 时存在一些挑战: 首先, 我们需要获得给定的推出集的出道口 @ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 。 我们通过学习在概率模型下共同分配推出的结果来解决这个问题,从这个模型中可以估计任何组合的出场时间@k\mathrm{pass}@k。 第二,即使有了这样的估计,找到估计通过量最高的 k k 的子集@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 是一个混合整数程序 。 因此,我们可以将我们的框架视为两个组成部分,即学习成果的联合分配(第3.1节),以及在选择时间解决这一混合组合方案(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Instead of using h i h_{i} directly in the correlation term, one could learn an encoder ℰ ψ \mathcal{E}_{\psi} of the representations and use ℰ ψ ​ ( h i ) \mathcal{E}_{\psi}(h_{i}) in its place, but its helpfulness depends on the amount of data. Since our data is limited, we keep h i h_{i} fixed, so that Q θ Q_{\theta} is the only learned component, and for the same reason we use a simple linear model Q θ ​ ( h ) = θ ⊤ ​ h + θ 0 Q_{\theta}(h)=\theta^{\top}h+\theta_{0} for Q θ Q_{\theta} , as in the Linear Probe [ 54 ] . Unlike the Linear Probe, which is trained on the correctness of each rollout separately, Q θ Q_{\theta} is trained on the joint outcomes of all rollouts of a question, so the quality it learns already accounts for the correlation between them. blocks.en: Proposition 2 shows how the correlation strength ρ \rho controls where PKTP sits between the two baselines. At ρ = 0 \rho=0 the rollouts are independent, the expansion reduces to ∑ i ∈ S log ⁡ Φ ⁡ ( − q i ) \sum_{i\in S}\log\Phi(-q_{i}) , and PKTP ranks the rollouts by quality, as Linear Probe does. A rollout added to a set of t t rollouts pays t t such penalties, so the first pick is decided by quality alone, and as the set grows the penalties add up until they outweigh the differences in quality, after which PKTP spreads its picks out, as RepExp does. The larger ρ \rho is, the sooner this happens, so ρ \rho sets how fast PKTP moves from Linear Probe to RepExp as k k grows.

blocks.en: Appendix C makes the two ends of this behavior precise for a fixed ρ \rho . At small k k , if the gap between the k k th and ( k + 1 ) (k+1) th largest qualities exceeds a constant multiple of k ​ ρ 2 k\rho^{2} , PKTP keeps exactly the k k candidates with the largest q i q_{i} , as Linear Probe does, and in the same order when this holds at every budget up to k k . At large k k , when a few candidates of high quality stand out from a bulk of lower quality, the objective of PKTP, averaged over the bulk qualities, reduces to the RepExp objective plus a term for these candidates. Its minimizers therefore keep them and nearly maximize the RepExp objective. Finally, the conditions of these two results do not conflict. We construct a single model, with one quality distribution and one value of ρ \rho , in which PKTP follows Linear Probe at small k k , while its averaged objective reduces to the RepExp objective as k k grows.

blocks.en: We evaluate on eight open-weight reasoning models in two size tiers. The small tier is Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B [ 49 ] , OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B [ 31 ] and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B [ 15 ] , and the large tier is Qwen3-8B, OpenMath-Nemotron-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Skywork-OR1-Math-7B [ 16 ] . Every model generates its rollouts with temperature 0.8 0.8 , top- p p of 0.95 0.95 , and a full token budget of B = 32,768 B=32{,}768 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们按两个大小等级评估八个开放式推理模型。 小等级为:Quen3-0.6B,Quen3-1.7B [49],OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B [31]和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-1.5B [15],大等级为:Quen3-8B,OpenMath-Nemotron-7B,DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B和Skywork-OR1-Math-7B [16]. 每个型号生成其推出时的温度为0.8 0.8,上-p为0.95 0.95,并有B=32 768 B=32{,}768个活塞.

blocks.en: We pool problems from several benchmark sources rather than a single one, since a pruning policy has to be trained on part of the problems and evaluated on the rest, and no single competition benchmark is large enough for both. The two model tiers are evaluated on different benchmark substrates, chosen so that neither tier is saturated. Both tiers use AIME 2024, 2025 and 2026 and HMMT 2024, 2025 and 2026 [ 2 ] , together with RIMO-N [ 9 ] . The small tier adds BeyondAIME [ 4 ] , OlymMATH (Easy) [ 37 ] and Omni-MATH levels 7 and 8 [ 14 ] , while the large tier replaces these by AMO-Bench [ 27 ] , OlymMATH (Hard) and Omni-MATH levels 8 and 9. This gives around 600 600 problems per model. For each model we then remove the problems on which it generates all correct or all wrong solutions in 128 128 trials.
blocks.zh: 我们从若干基准来源而不是单一基准来源汇集出问题,因为必须就部分问题对政策进行调整,并对其余问题进行评估,没有单一的竞争基准足以满足两者的需要。 两个模型层根据不同的基准底物进行评估,选择这些底物时,两个分层都不饱和。 两层均使用AIME 2024,2025和2026以及HMMT 2024,2025和2026 [2],并同时使用RIMO-N [9]. 该小层级增加了BeyondAIME [4],OlymmATH (Easy) [37]和Omni-MATH 等分级7和8 [14],而大层级则以AMO-Bench [27],OlymmATH (Hard)和Omni-MATH等分级8和9来取而代之. 这给每个模型大约600600个问题. 然后,我们针对每一种模式,在128 128次试验中消除产生所有正确或错误解决办法的问题。

blocks.en: A completed rollout counts as correct when its final answer matches the reference answer of the problem. We take that answer from the \boxed{} expression of the rollout and ask a Qwen3-32B judge [ 49 ] whether it is equivalent to the reference answer. We use a judge rather than a symbolic checker such as math-verify [ 24 ] , because benchmarks like AMO-Bench have descriptive answers that a symbolic checker cannot handle.
blocks.zh: 完成的推出,如果其最后答复与问题的参考答复相符,则算作正确。 我们从 \boxed \\\\ 表示推出, 问一个 Qune3 - 32B 法官 [49] 这是否相当于 参考答案 。 我们使用一个法官,而不是像数学验证这样的象征性的核对器[24],因为像AMO-Bench这样的基准有象征性的核对器无法处理的描述性答案.

blocks.en: Only a few hundred problems are available for each model, so a single split into training and test problems would leave too few on either side, and we evaluate with cross-validation instead. For each model we partition its problems into eight folds, with each benchmark spread evenly across the folds. Each fold serves once as the test set while the learned components are trained on the other seven, so every problem is scored exactly once by a model that was not trained on it. One such pass over all eight folds forms a repetition. Because the outcome of a repetition depends on how the problems happen to be divided, we run 20 20 repetitions, each with a new random partition obtained by shuffling the problems of every benchmark before assigning them to folds, and with fresh random seeds for training. Every reported number is the average over the 20 20 repetitions, and its standard error is computed across them. For RepExp we set the regularizer to τ = 1 \tau=1 . For all methods, the representation h i h_{i} of a partial rollout is the EMA of its hidden states with rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} .
blocks.zh: 每个模型都只有几百个问题,所以单分为一个培训和测试问题就会使两边都太少,我们用交叉验证来评估。 对于每个模型,我们将其问题分成8个折叠,每个基准均匀地分布在折叠上. 每个折叠都一度作为测试集,而学习到的组件则在其他7个上被训练出,因此每个问题都完全被一个没有经过训练的模型打出一次分数. 一个这样的通过 在所有八折构成重复。 因为重复的结果取决于问题是如何发生的分裂,所以我们运行了20个重复,每个重复都有一个新的随机分区,通过在分配每个基准到折叠之前将每个基准的问题排出来得到,并且有新鲜的随机种子进行训练. 每个报告的数字是20次重复的平均数字,其标准误差是在20次重复中计算的。 对于 RepExp 我们设置正则器为\\\ tau=1 。 就所有方法而言,部分推出的表示h i h_{i}是其隐藏状态的EMA,比例为10 - 3 10^{-3}.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Evaluation and Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验评价和比较

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports our main setting, in which each method selects k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } k\in\{1,2,4,8,16\} of the N = 128 N=128 rollouts of a problem from their prefixes, and we set the cutoff threshold to T = 4000 T=4000 tokens. For every model it shows the pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k of each pruning policy minus that of Random (Pass@ k k ), pooled over all test problems. Random keeps k k rollouts chosen uniformly at random, which is equivalent to sampling k k rollouts without any pruning, so it is the natural reference point. The absolute numbers are given in Table 1 and the breakdown by benchmark in Appendix D .

blocks.en: Figure 4: Linear Probe keeps a cluster of rollouts that fail together. The 128 128 rollouts of one problem (Qwen3-8B, AMO-Bench), projected on the first two principal components of their representations, with correct rollouts in green and wrong rollouts in red. The 16 16 rollouts ranked highest by the Linear Probe (blue rings) lie close together and are all wrong, while 16 16 random picks (gray rings) include 7 7 correct rollouts.
blocks.zh: 图4:线性探测器保持了一组推出失败的组合. 一个问题(Quen3-8B, AMO-Bench)的128个推出,其前两个主要组成部分都预测到,绿色的推出和红色的错误推出是正确的。 被"蓝环"(Linear Probe (Blue ring))排名最高的16个滚出物相靠拢,都是错误的,而16个"随机取出物"(Gray ring)包括了7个"正确"的出物相.

blocks.en: As evident in Fig. 3 , the Linear Probe performs strongly at k = 1 k=1 , but as k k increases it gets closer and closer to Random, as in the Qwen models, and in some cases it even becomes worse than Random at large k k . This can be attributed to a bias towards a cluster of rollouts that the model predicts to be correct but that may not be, in the case where the classifier is wrong. In other words, ranking by the probe sharpens the distribution of the kept rollouts around what the probe considers correct. This mirrors the effect observed in reinforcement learning, where models trained with GRPO outperform their base models at small k k but are outperformed by them at large k k [ 53 ] . As an example, Fig. 4 shows the 128 128 rollouts of one problem (Qwen3-8B, AMO-Bench), projected on the first two principal components of their representations. The 16 16 rollouts ranked highest by the probe are all close to each other and all wrong, while 16 16 random picks include 7 7 correct ones.
blocks.zh: 如图3所显示,线性探测器在克=一克=一时的性能很强,但随着克的增大,它越来越接近"随机"(Random),如"Quen"模型,在某些情况下甚至比"Random"在"大克"(Random)更糟糕. 这可归因于对一组推出的偏好,模型预测这组推出是正确的,但在分类器错误的情况下可能并非如此. 换句话说,由探测器进行排名,可以使所保持的展开量围绕探测器认为正确的分布更加清晰. 这反映了在强化学习中观察到的效果,在这种学习中,受过GRPO训练的模型在小kk上超过了其基础模型,但在大kk [53]上却被它们所超越. 例如,图4显示一个问题(Qune3-8B、AMO-Bench)的128个128个推出,预测其表述的前两个主要部分。 被探测器评分最高的16个出道曲均相去相近并全部出错,而16个出道曲则有7个出道曲.

blocks.en: Figure 5: RepExp keeps outliers that are unlikely to be correct. The 128 128 rollouts of one problem (Qwen3-8B, Omni-MATH), embedded in two dimensions by multidimensional scaling of their representations, with correct rollouts in green and wrong rollouts in red. After a random first pick, RepExp (pink rings, numbered in pick order) selects rollouts far from the rest, and all 4 4 of its picks are wrong, while 4 4 random picks (gray rings) include 1 1 correct rollout.
blocks.zh: 图5:RepExp保持不可能准确的出值. 一个问题(Quen3-8B,Omni-MATH)的128个出炉,通过多层面地放大其表现而嵌入了两个维度,在绿色和红色上正确出炉. 在随机第一取出后,RepExp(平克环,按取出顺序编号)会选择远离其他取出,而其取出的所有4个取出都是错误的取出,而取出4个取出(灰色取出环)则包括取出1个正确的取出.

blocks.en: Figure 3 also shows that RepExp behaves in the opposite way to the Linear Probe. At k = 1 k=1 it shows, as expected, a performance similar to Random, since its first pick is random. As k k increases, the general trend is that RepExp gets better and better than Random, especially at k = 16 k=16 (e.g., the DeepSeek-R1-Distill models). Interestingly, however, for moderate k k it is sometimes outperformed by Random, for instance on OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B and Qwen3-8B. We attribute this to a tendency of RepExp to favor outliers at small and moderate k k , since the rollouts farthest from those already selected are often unusual rollouts that are unlikely to be correct. A similar effect is reported by Tuyls et al. [39] , where RepExp stops helping under high-temperature sampling, since the less coherent responses look novel in representation space yet do not necessarily contain correct answers. As an example, Fig. 5 shows the 128 128 rollouts of one problem (Qwen3-8B, Omni-MATH), embedded in two dimensions with multidimensional scaling on their representations. After its first, random pick, RepExp selects outliers far from the other rollouts, and all 4 4 of its picks are wrong, while 4 4 random picks include 1 1 correct one.
blocks.zh: 图3还显示RepExp的行为与线性探测相反. K = 1 k = 1 它显示的性能与 Random 相类似,因为它的第一个取法是随机的. 随着kk的增加,总的趋势是RepExp比Random更好,更好,尤其是以k=16k=16(例如DeepSeek-R1-Distill模型). 不过,有趣的是,对于中度克来说,有时它的表现会被Random所超越,例如在OpenMath-Nemotron-1.5B和Qune3-8B上. 我们将此归因于RepExp倾向于在中小 k k 中偏好外出者的趋势,因为与已经选中者相去最远的推出常常是不寻常的推出,不太可能正确. Tuyls等人报告了类似的效应。 [39],其中RepExp停止在高温采样下提供帮助,因为不太一致的响应在代表空间中看起来很新颖,但不一定包含正确的答案. 例如,图5显示一个问题(Quen3-8B,Omni-MATH)的128个128个推出,嵌入两个维度,其表达方式具有多维尺度。 在它的第一,随机取出后,RepExp会选择远离其他推出的出局者,而它的取出者全部有4个4个是错的,而4个4个随机取出者包括1个正确取出者.

blocks.en: Finally, Fig. 3 shows that PKTP outperforms both the Linear Probe and RepExp, and its advantage is clearest at moderate k k , where each baseline suffers from its own bias. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at k = 4 k=4 , for example, PKTP is 3.0 3.0 points above the Linear Probe and 3.2 3.2 points above RepExp. On Qwen3-0.6B it leads both baselines by more than 2 2 points at every k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 , and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B it is 3.3 3.3 points above the Linear Probe at k = 4 k=4 . Unlike the two baselines, PKTP also stays above Random on every model for k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 , since it keeps the correctness signal of the probe while spreading the kept rollouts over outcomes that are unlikely to fail together. At large k k , however, the performance of PKTP and RepExp gets closer. We believe this is due to the weak correctness signal in the embeddings of the partial rollouts, which raises the question of how a quality embedding can be obtained from a partial rollout, and whether this is possible at all.
blocks.zh: 最后,费格。 3显示,PKTP在Linear Probe和RepExp上都表现优于后者,其优势在中度k k 上最为明显,每个基线都受到自身偏差的影响. 例如在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-1.5B以克=4克=4时,PKTP比Linear Probe高3.0分,比RepExp高3.2 3.2分. 在Qwen3-0.6B上,每千分之2千分之2的基线比2多出2分,在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B上,在克=4千分之4的线性探测器上方为3.33.3分. 与两个基线不同的是,PKTP也停留在Random上方的每个模型上为 k → 2 k\\ geq 2,因为它保持了探测器的正确性信号,同时将所保持的展开在不可能一起失败的结果上. 然而,在大的kk中,PKTP和RepExp的性能会更接近. 我们认为,这是因为部分推出的嵌入中正确性信号很弱,这提出了如何通过部分推出获得质量嵌入的问题,以及这是否完全有可能.

4.3 Effect of the cutoff threshold
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 临界阈值的影响

blocks.en: Figure 6: A later cutoff improves PKTP. Pass@ 4 4 on Qwen3-1.7B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B as the cutoff T T grows from 2000 2000 to 8000 8000 tokens, with N = 128 N=128 . PKTP is the best method for every T ≥ 4000 T\geq 4000 and keeps improving with longer prefixes, while the Linear Probe and RepExp gain much less, and the Linear Probe on Qwen3-1.7B even drifts below Random. Bands are one standard error.
blocks.zh: 图6:以后的断接方式改善了PKTP. 由于截取T从2000年增长到80008,000个令牌,而N=128个N=128个,因此在Quen3-1.7B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B上通过@4 4. PKTP是每架T ≥ 4000 T\geq 4000 的最好方法,并用更长的前缀不断改进,而Linear Probe和RepExp的得分则要少得多,而Qwen3-1.7B上的Linear Probe甚至会漂流到随机下. 乐队是一个标准错误.

blocks.en: An important aspect of pruning is the cutoff threshold T T , and how the algorithm behaves as the cutoff grows. Figure 6 varies T T on Qwen3-1.7B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B. For every T ≥ 4000 T\geq 4000 , PKTP outperforms all other methods on both models. An interesting observation is that a later cutoff in general improves the performance of PKTP. On Qwen3-1.7B its pass@ 4 4 rises from 63.5 % 63.5\% at T = 2000 T=2000 to 65.9 % 65.9\% at T = 8000 T=8000 , and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B from 57.4 % 57.4\% to 61.7 % 61.7\% . Intuitively, the more tokens are generated, the more is revealed about the quality of a rollout and where it is heading, so there is more signal to exploit. Interestingly, however, the same does not necessarily happen for the Linear Probe and RepExp. On Qwen3-1.7B, for example, the Linear Probe drifts down from 64.2 % 64.2\% to 62.3 % 62.3\% and ends below Random. One reason can be the representation we use. Since the EMA with rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} effectively averages over the last 1000 1000 tokens, it may lose the signal in the earlier tokens.
blocks.zh: 剪接的一个重要方面是截取阈值 T T,以及算法如何随着截取的增长而表现. 图6在Quen3-1.7B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B上有不同的T. 每4000T\克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 一个有趣的观察是,以后的断接一般会提高PKTP的性能. 在Qwen3-1.7B上, 4 4 的通过率从 63.5% 63.5% 在T = 2000 T = 2000 上上升到 65.9% 65.9% 在T = 8000 T = 800 000 上, 在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B上, 从 57.4% 57.4% 到 61.7% 61.7% 。 直观地说, 创造的代号越多, 显示推出的质量就越好, 其方向也就越好, 因此有更多的信号可以利用。 然而有趣的是,线性探测器和RepExp不一定也会出现同样的情况. On Qune3–1.7B,例如线性探测器从64.2%的64.2\%下降到62.3%到62.3%的62.3\%到"随机"以下. 一个原因可能是我们使用的代表性。 由于速率10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 }的EMA实际上平均在最后1000个令牌上,它可能会失去早期令牌中的信号.

blocks.en: 4.4 Effect of the pool size
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 池大小的影响

blocks.en: Figure 7: PKTP leads once the pool is large enough. Pass@ 4 4 on Qwen3-1.7B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B as the pool size N N grows from 32 32 to 128 128 , with T = 4000 T=4000 . PKTP is the best method for every N N on Qwen3-1.7B and from N = 80 N=80 on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, where the Linear Probe falls as the pool grows and stays below Random. Bands are one standard error.
blocks.zh: 图7:一旦池子足够大,PKTP就领先. Pass@ 4 4 on Qune3-1.7B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B,因为游泳池大小N由32 32增长到128 128,其中T=4000 T=4000. PKTP是Quen3–1.7B上每个NN的最佳方法,而从DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B上从N=80N=80,其中线性探测器会随着池子的生长而下降并停留在"随机"下. 乐队是一个标准错误.

blocks.en: Another important aspect of pruning is the size N N of the pool the k k rollouts are chosen from. Figure 7 varies N N on Qwen3-1.7B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B. PKTP outperforms all other methods for every N N on Qwen3-1.7B, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B once the pool reaches N = 80 N=80 . A larger pool offers more candidates to choose from, and on Qwen3-1.7B both baselines benefit from it, with RepExp rising from 62.9 % 62.9\% at N = 32 N=32 to 63.9 % 63.9\% at N = 128 N=128 as the pool becomes more diverse and the Linear Probe from 62.1 % 62.1\% to 63.1 % 63.1\% . Interestingly, however, the same does not hold on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, where the Linear Probe falls from 58.1 % 58.1\% to 56.4 % 56.4\% and stays below Random for every N N , and RepExp falls from 59.5 % 59.5\% at N = 48 N=48 to 58.6 % 58.6\% , while PKTP rises from 58.8 % 58.8\% to 59.7 % 59.7\% . One reason can be that a larger pool also contains more outliers, which raises the chance that extreme cases like RepExp and the Linear Probe select them at a moderate k k such as k = 4 k=4 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PKTP, a pruning framework that chooses which partial rollouts to keep by directly optimizing pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k . PKTP learns the joint distribution of the rollouts’ outcomes with a latent Gaussian model, approximates the resulting likelihood in closed form, and selects the kept set greedily, with an approximation guarantee on the surrogate objective. Across eight reasoning models, it outperforms both quality-based and diversity-based pruning, and the gains are largest at moderate k k , where each of these baselines suffers from its own bias. Since PKTP can be combined with any representation of partial rollouts, representations that better capture the correctness of a rollout would directly strengthen it, and developing them is a natural direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 PKTP , 即通过直接优化通过@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k 来选择要保存哪些部分推出的普跑框架 。 PKTP用潜在的高斯模型来学习推开结果的联合分布,大概得出了封闭形式的可能性,并贪婪地选择了所保持的套装,在取而代位目标上有一个相近的保证. 在整个8个推理模型中,它的表现都超过了基于质量和基于多样性的探索,收益最大的是中度千克,在这些基准中,每个基准都有其自身的偏差。 自兹 PKTP可以与任何部分推出的表示相结合,更好地反映推出的正确性将直接加强它,开发这些表示是未来工作的自然方向.

blocks.en: C.1 Overview of Appendix C
blocks.zh: C.1 附录C概述

blocks.en: Section C.2 states the three assumptions that the results rely on. The first is that most candidates, the bulk, have qualities drawn independently from a fixed bounded distribution, while a few candidates, the spikes, have fixed qualities above every bulk quality. In other words, the pool contains a few spikes whose quality is higher than that of any other candidate, while the bulk consists of lower-quality candidates drawn from a common distribution. The second is that the representations are h i = ρ ​ v i h_{i}=\rho v_{i} with ‖ v i ‖ 2 ≤ 1 \|v_{i}\|_{2}\leq 1 for a fixed scale ρ \rho , and do not depend on the qualities. Thus ρ \rho caps how strongly two candidates can be correlated, since Cov ⁡ ( 𝐙 i , 𝐙 j ∣ H ) = h i ⊤ ​ h j ≤ ρ 2 \operatorname{Cov}(\mathbf{Z}_{i},\mathbf{Z}_{j}\mid H)=h_{i}^{\top}h_{j}\leq\rho^{2} , as in Proposition 2 , and the similarity between candidates carries no information about their qualities. The third is needed only for large budgets. There we minimize the objective over a family of size- k k sets, and we require these sets to be diverse, meaning that their representations point in all directions rather than being concentrated in a few.
blocks.zh: C.2节说明了结果所依赖的三个假设。 第一,大多数候选人,即批量候选人,具有独立于固定范围分配的素质,而少数候选人,即批量候选人,具有高于每批量质量的固定素质。 换句话说,人才库中有一些比任何其他候选人素质高的分数,而大部分是来自共同分配的素质较低的候选人。 第二种说法是:H i = ρ v i _{i}=\rho v_{i}i}i} 与 ‖ ‖  v 2 ≤ 1 \|v_{i}\|_{2}\leq. 1 对于一个固定的尺度 $\rho, 不取决于质量。 因此,\rho上限 如何强烈两个候选人可以关联, 因为Cov \ \ (Z i, Z j \ ) = h i \ h j \\ operatorname{ Cov} (\ mathbf{Z}_{i},\ mathbf{Z}_{j}\mid) H)=h_{i}^{\top}h_{j}\j}\leq\rho}2}如提案2所言,候选人之间的相似性没有说明其素质. 第三个只是大预算需要。 在那里,我们把目标最小化于一个大小的-k k sets的家族,我们要求这些组合是多样化的,也就是说,它们的表述指向所有方向,而不是集中在少数方向.

blocks.en: Section C.3 shows that at small budgets the two rules agree when the gap between the k k th and ( k + 1 ) (k+1) th largest qualities, measured as log ⁡ Φ ⁡ ( − q ( k + 1 ) ) − log ⁡ Φ ⁡ ( − q ( k ) ) \log\Phi(-q_{(k+1)})-\log\Phi(-q_{(k)}) , exceeds a constant multiple of k ​ ρ 2 k\rho^{2} , which bounds the correlation terms that k k picks can accumulate. The surrogate greedy rule then returns exactly the top- k k set of the probe-style rule, and if this condition holds at every budget up to k k , it also adds these candidates in the same order.

blocks.en: Section C.4 shows that at large budgets PKTP and RepExp optimize nearly the same objective. To see this, we average the objective of PKTP over the bulk qualities, for the diverse sets of the third assumption. Apart from a constant and an error that shrinks as k k grows, minimizing this average is the same as keeping the spikes and maximizing the RepExp objective. This is a statement about the objectives, and it does not mean that PKTP and RepExp pick the same set.
blocks.zh: C.4节显示,在大预算中,PKTP和RepExp优化了几乎相同的目标。 为了看到这一点,我们把PKTP的目标平均于批量质量,用于第三种假设的不同组合。 除了一个常数和一个随着kk增长而收缩的错误外,将这个平均值最小化也等于保持了突起并最大化了RepExp目标. 这是关于目标的声明,并不意味着PKTP和RepExp选择相同的集.

blocks.en: Section C.5 constructs an explicit model in which both results hold. It fixes one quality distribution and one correlation scale ρ \rho . In this model, the surrogate greedy rule follows the probe-style rule for every k ≤ 3 k\leq 3 , while the large-budget result holds as k k grows.
blocks.zh: C.5节构建了一个明确的模式,两种结果都坚持不变。 它会修正一个质量分布和一个相关比例 ^\rho 。 在这个模型中,被替代的贪婪规则遵循了每克 → 3 k\leq 3 的探测器风格规则,而大预算结果则随着k k 的生长而保持.

blocks.en: C.2 Assumptions
blocks.zh: C.2 假设

blocks.en: We use k k for the selection budget, with 1 ≤ k ≤ N 1\leq k\leq N for a fixed candidate pool. The three assumptions below concern the quality scores and the representations of the candidates. (A1) Bulk and spikes. There is a fixed set O = { o 1 , … , o r } O=\{o_{1},\ldots,o_{r}\} of r ≥ 1 r\geq 1 candidates, the spikes. The qualities of all other candidates, the bulk, are drawn independently from a distribution 𝒟 q \mathcal{D}_{q} supported in a fixed interval [ w 0 , w ] ⊆ [ − M , M ] [w_{0},w]\subseteq[-M,M] for a finite M M . The spike qualities are fixed, lie in [ − M , M ] [-M,M] , and satisfy q o 1 > q o 2 > ⋯ > q o r > w , q_{o_{1}}>q_{o_{2}}>\cdots>q_{o_{r}}>w, (79) so every spike has a higher quality than every bulk candidate. (A2) Correlation scale. The representations are h i = ρ ​ v i h_{i}=\rho v_{i} with ‖ v i ‖ 2 ≤ 1 \|v_{i}\|_{2}\leq 1 and a fixed 0 < ρ ≤ 1 0<\rho\leq 1 . They are deterministic, so they do not depend on the bulk qualities. A small ρ \rho means weak correlations between candidates, as in Proposition 2 . The small-budget result needs ρ \rho to be small compared to a quality gap, while the large-budget results allow any fixed ρ > 0 \rho>0 . (A3) Diverse representations. For large budgets, we let k → ∞ k\to\infty along a sequence of candidate pools of sizes N k ≥ k N_{k}\geq k , while the dimension d d , the spikes and their qualities, the scale ρ \rho , and the distribution 𝒟 q \mathcal{D}_{q} stay fixed. The large-budget results minimize the objective over a family 𝒜 k \mathcal{A}_{k} of size- k k subsets of [ N k ] [N_{k}] with the following properties. It is deterministic and chosen independently of the bulk qualities. It is nonempty for every sufficiently large k k , and every S ∈ 𝒜 k S\in\mathcal{A}_{k} satisfies c 0 ​ k ​ I d ⪯ ∑ i ∈ S v i ​ v i ⊤ ⪯ C 0 ​ k ​ I d , ‖ ∑ i ∈ S ∖ O v i ‖ 2 ≤ B 0 , c_{0}kI_{d}\preceq\sum_{i\in S}v_{i}v_{i}^{\top}\preceq C_{0}kI_{d},\qquad\left\|\sum_{i\in S\setminus O}v_{i}\right\|_{2}\leq B_{0}, (80) where c 0 , C 0 , B 0 > 0 c_{0},C_{0},B_{0}>0 do not depend on k k or S S . The first condition says that the representations in S S cover every direction, with a total weight that grows linearly in k k , and the second says that the representations of the bulk candidates nearly cancel out. blocks.en: The spikes are what keep this result meaningful in large pools. With bulk qualities alone, the gap between the k k th and ( k + 1 ) (k+1) th largest qualities typically shrinks as the pool grows, so the condition of Theorem 3 eventually fails. The gaps around the spikes do not depend on the bulk, so Corollary 2 holds for every pool size, while the bulk qualities keep a fixed variance.

blocks.en: Test-time scaling generates many rollouts per problem and aggregates them [ 44 , 3 , 35 , 48 ] , and a growing line of work saves compute by stopping unpromising rollouts early. One family uses the model’s own confidence, such as token-level confidence or its self-estimate of success, to decide which rollouts to continue [ 30 , 13 ] . Another scores partial rollouts with a reward model [ 36 ] or with a probe on the hidden states [ 54 , 1 , 25 ] . Yang et al. [51] concurrently use such a probe for a beam search over partial rollouts, pruning weak rollouts and branching new rollouts from the best prefixes. All of these score each rollout on its own and keep the highest-scoring ones, which is the pure exploitation extreme of Section 2 . At the other extreme, RepExp [ 39 ] selects rollouts whose representations are least explained by those already chosen, without using their quality. PKTP sits between the two, since it models how the outcomes of the rollouts depend on each other and chooses the set with the highest predicted pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k .

[51] 同时使用这种探测器在部分展开时进行光束搜索,推开弱展开并从最优前缀分出新的展开. 所有这些分数都是自己推出的, 并且保持最高分数, 这是第2节的纯粹剥削极端。 在另一个极端,RepExp [39] 选择其表述最少由已经选中的人解释的推出,而不使用其质量。 PKTP坐落在两者之间,因为它模拟了推出结果如何互相依赖,并选择了预想通过最高的组合@ k\mathrm{pass}@k.

blocks.en: Pass@ k k is a standard evaluation metric for reasoning and code generation, and several works optimize it during training. Walder and Karkhanis [41] derive low-variance policy-gradient estimators for pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k , Chen et al. [8] use pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k as the reward to balance exploration and exploitation, and Chow et al. [10] fine-tune a model for best-of- N N inference. Chen et al. [7] reward a group of responses for both quality and diversity, measuring diversity by the determinant of their similarity matrix. These are post-training methods, while PKTP leaves the model unchanged and optimizes pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k at inference time by choosing which partial rollouts to continue. Concurrently, Wu et al. [47] also leave the reasoning model unchanged, but use pass ​ @ ​ k \mathrm{pass}@k as the reward to train a planner that writes a different outline for each rollout before it is generated. They thus change how the rollouts are sampled, while PKTP takes N N independently sampled partial rollouts as given and chooses which k k of them to continue.
blocks.zh: Pass@ kk是用于推理和代码生成的标准评价度量衡,在训练期间有好几项工作对其进行了优化. Walder and Karkhanis [41] 获得低波动政策等级的通过估计器 @ k\mathrm{pass}@k , 陈等. [8] 将通行证@k\mathrm{pass}@k作为平衡勘探和开发的奖励,而Chow et al. [10] 微调最佳NN推论模型. 陈等. [7] 奖励一组对质量和多样性的反应,根据其相似性矩阵的决定因素衡量多样性。 这些是训练后的方法,而PKTP则保留模型不变并优化通过推论时间的@ k\ mathrm{ pass}@k,选择哪些部分推出继续. 同时,吴等. [47] 也保留推理模式不变,但使用出道口@k\mathrm{pass}@k作为奖励,在每次推出之前训练一个为出道书写出不同大纲的规划者. 因此,它们改变了推出样品的取样方式,而PKTP则按给定的N N独立抽取了部分推出样品,并选择其中哪克继续。

blocks.en: The same objective appears in information retrieval as the expected 1-call@ k k , the probability that at least one of the top k k documents is relevant. Chen and Karger [6] optimize it greedily, and Sanner et al. [34] show that greedy optimization under a latent subtopic model of relevance leads to diverse rankings, in the same way that our latent factor leads to diverse kept sets. In Bayesian optimization, the batch probability of improvement is the probability that at least one point of a batch improves on the incumbent, and it is monotone and submodular, so it can be maximized greedily [ 46 , 32 ] . Other methods balance quality and diversity with a hand-set trade-off, such as maximal marginal relevance [ 5 ] and determinantal point processes [ 22 ] . In contrast to these works, PKTP applies to partial reasoning rollouts, learns the joint distribution of their outcomes from their representations, and optimizes a closed-form surrogate that keeps the submodularity of the exact objective.
blocks.zh: 在信息检索中出现的目标与预期的1-call@kk 相同,即至少一个最顶级的kk文档是相关的概率. 陈和克格[6]贪婪地优化了它,而桑纳等. [34] 显示在潜在的分专题相关模式下贪婪地优化会导致不同的排名,其方式与我们的潜在因素导致多样化的连续组合相同. 在贝叶斯优化中,批量的改进概率是,批量中至少有一分改善于当事者的概率,并且是单酮和亚模,因此可以被贪婪地最大化[46,32]. 其他方法兼顾质量和多样性与取舍,例如最大边际关联性[5]和决定因素点过程[22]。 与这些作品相比,PKTP适用于部分推理的展开,从它们的表现中学习出它们的结果的联合分布,并优化了一种闭式代词来保持精确目标的亚模.
